newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLO/Bund yield spread expected to narrow further.
newsitem.headline: OLO/Bund yield spread expected to narrow further.

text.p: The 10-year yield spread between Belgian linear bonds and Bunds is expected to dip in the next few days if OLO coupons are reinvested in the long end of the market, traders said on Wednesday.
The spread was hovering at 12 to 13 basis points on Wednesday which traders said was normal after it had widened on the back of the normal and exchange OLO auctions.
"If there are signs of bottoming out, end investors might reinvest their OLO coupons," one trader said.
OLOs were generally weaker with the benchmark 2007 OLO yielding 6.01 percent against 5.99 percent on Tuesday.
Traders said they expected another 25 basis points U.S. interest rate rise in May, which they said would be sufficient to keep the credibility of the Federal Reserve intact.
